properties.description: Khong bao gio ton tai trang thai 'da giao nhung bi doi nguoc lai' - mot don hang da giao thanh cong khong the bi sua trang thai ve truoc do.
Khong bao gio ton tai trang thai 'da huy nhung van duoc giao' - mot don hang da huy (va coupon/hang da duoc hoan) khong duoc phep tiep tuc giao.
Ton tai it nhat mot duong di hop le tu trang thai khoi tao den 'Da giao' (tinh kha thi cua he thong - khong bi thiet ke qua chat den muc khong the giao hang duoc).
Khong bao gio ton tai trang thai 'da giao nhung bi doi nguoc lai'. DU KIEN: VI PHAM trong he thong that, vi PUT /api/orders/:id khong kiem tra status hien tai va khong yeu cau xac thuc.

Khong bao gio ton tai trang thai 'da huy nhung van duoc giao'. DU KIEN: VI PHAM trong he thong that vi cung ly do tren - co the 'hoi sinh' don da huy va tiep tuc giao hang du coupon/hang da duoc xu ly hoan tra.
Ton tai duong di hop le den 'Da giao' (kiem tra he thong khong bi hong hoan toan, vong doi binh thuong van hoat dong duoc).
